name: Article 5 Due-Diligence Evidence Record
outcome: Records, per position and period, which Article 5 verification and ongoing-monitoring duties an investor performed, the evidence behind each, and what remains outstanding as a named gap list. Single-node chainless pack — no chain exists for a standalone node. This kernel has no asserted-vs-recomputed comparison surface (it assembles an evidence record; it does not recompute a figure against a report), so it is registered for pack resolution and the shared kernel-runner execution path but is not wired into `helm check`'s CHECK_ADAPTERS — see SECZ-PACK-1's check-off note.
